Reach in spikes

Views that don't become buyers

One of your last 7 reels reached 858k views and another 226k, while the rest sat between 7k and 141k. When a reel takes off, there is nothing to buy that turns that attention into revenue.

One date

A workshop that ends when the date passes

Create Your Best Q4 ran live on Friday 9 October and its page is no longer live. Everyone who finds you after that date has no workshop to join.

A big jump

Free, then straight to 1:1

Someone who loves the podcast but isn't ready for coaching has nothing to say yes to in between. They keep listening, and you never find out who they are.

No buyer signal

Discovery calls with people who've never bought

A free call is booked on interest alone. A purchase shows intent. Without one, there's no way to tell who is ready before they're on your calendar.

Your content does its job. What's missing is a first purchase that pays for ads and shows you who is ready for 1:1.

Sound familiar?

You know something needs to shift. You just don't know where to start.

  • The same thoughts replay at night, and listening to one more podcast hasn't changed the pattern.

  • You want to trust where you're going, even before you have proof.

Here's what you'll learn

Seven days. One clear shift.

Notice the loop

How a thought spiral starts, and the simple pause that lets you step outside it.

Find the belief underneath

Identify the pattern or belief behind what keeps coming up, in your own words.

Ask better questions

Swap “why does this always happen to me?” for questions that open up new answers.

Start assuming the best

Use the reframe cards to practise a kinder first thought about yourself and others.

Listen to your jealousy

Turn comparison into information about what you actually want next.

Trust without proof

Questions

Before you start

Is this therapy?

No. It's coaching and education: tools, reflection and practice. If you're going through something that needs clinical support, please speak to a licensed professional.

How much time does it take?

One short audio lesson and one journal page a day, about 15 minutes. Go at your own pace, and keep access.

I already listen to your podcast. Is this different?

Yes. The podcast gives you ideas. The kit gives you a 7-day order to practise them in, with a journal to do the work on paper.

Do I need to print anything?

No. The journal and cards work on your phone or tablet, or print them if you like writing by hand.

What happens after the 7 days?

If you want to keep going, The Highest Self Reset goes deeper over 30 days, and you can apply for 1:1 coaching with me.
